new_theses.description: New thesis proposals, each referenced by at least one evidence link.

local_id.description: Local reference for this new thesis in the answer; not a database ID.

description.description: The proposed research question, stated clearly.

outcome.description: The one quantity for one period, or the one event, this thesis tracks. It may name the reference it is measured against, the event's own other outcomes (a slip past its date, an abandonment), judged as part of that event, and context. A second quantity or event an analyst would bet on separately is not part of it: it is its own thesis when section 3 says to propose one, otherwise evidence.

period.description: The period or check date that settles the thesis: the one the item supports, or the one its reason fixes (section 3), with how it was set.

opens_as.description: The reason this thesis opens, one of the four in section 3.

settled_by.description: The public material that will settle the answer on a date (a filing, an official decision, a shipment confirmation, a statistics release).

closest_open_thesis.description: Exact ID of the open thesis closest to this one; null when the open list is empty.

why_a_separate_bet.description: Why an analyst would bet on this question separately from the closest open thesis: how their answers can move apart.

evidence.description: Evidence statements extracted from this item, with their thesis links.

local_id.description: Local reference for this evidence in the answer; not a database ID.

summary.description: Standalone faithful summary naming the actor and preserving relevant figures, periods and conditions.

source_passages.description: Contiguous verbatim passages from this source item that jointly support the summary; return each passage separately.

original_party.description: Party whose action, figure or claim is reported; null if unknown. Use the reporting outlet or author as the original party only for its own estimate, analysis or unnamed-source report.

reporting_speaker.description: Person or outlet making or reporting the statement in this item, when known; null if unknown.

statement_date.description: Original statement day as YYYY-MM-DD when known; null if the full day is unknown.

measure.description: The financial measure as the passage states it.

period.description: The period as stated; null when none is given.

value.description: The figure copied exactly from one of this item's passages, with its unit.

kind.description: actual: reported, including a balance as of a date; guidance: the company's own outlook; estimate: a named party's or consensus forecast.

basis.description: Scope and qualifications as stated (GAAP or non-GAAP, segment or company, conditions); null when none.

figures.description: The company's own useful financial figures this statement states (section 2, CONDITION); empty for any other statement. A statement with several useful figures stays one item and lists them all.

links.description: The existing or proposed theses this evidence informs; empty when it is material but no thesis takes it yet: it is kept in the company's record and linked when a covering thesis opens.

target_type.description: Whether the reference identifies an open thesis or a new proposal.

target_id.description: Exact supplied ID when existing, or local_id of a new thesis in this answer.

relevance.description: How this evidence informs the referenced thesis, distinguishing source claims from inference.

tier.description: Source tier of the statement; an unconfirmed or unnamed-source claim takes precedence as rumour.

statement_date_text.description: Original date or partial date as stated in the item; null when absent.

evidence_period.description: Period the fact, plan or forecast describes, as supported by the item; null when unknown.
